# SkinLabs

> SkinLabs is South Africa's independent, content-first skincare intelligence
> platform: a free AI skin-routine assessment, daily skincare science
> briefings, independent product reviews with local pricing, a weekly
> skincare podcast, and virtual consultations with South African
> dermatologists and aesthetic practitioners. All pricing is in South African
> Rand (ZAR). SkinLabs is not an e-commerce store — it does not sell physical
> products.

## Core offering

- **AI Formulator** (/ai-formulator): a free, 20-question skin assessment
  that generates a personalized AM/PM skincare routine, actives schedule and
  product-type recommendations. No account required to complete it — a free
  preview is generated instantly, with a deeper report available to members.
- **The Daily Skinny** (/newsroom): daily skincare science briefings
  translated for South African skin, climate and shelves, each with its own
  permalink at /newsroom/{slug}. One briefing is free to read in full every
  day; unlimited access is a paid membership benefit.
- **Reviews** (/reviews): independent South African product reviews scored
  on efficacy, value, texture and local-climate performance, with rand
  pricing compared across South African retailers (Clicks, Dis-Chem,
  Takealot, Faithful to Nature and brand-direct). Each product has its own
  permalink at /reviews/{slug}.
- **The Skin Deep Podcast** (/podcast): a weekly South African skincare
  podcast with show notes, timestamps and full transcripts, releasing every
  Wednesday. Each episode has its own permalink at /podcast/{slug}.
- **Book a Consultation** (/book-consultation): virtual consultations with
  South African dermatologists and aesthetic practitioners.
- **Pricing** (/pricing): Glow Explorer (free), Glow Insider (R99/month) and
  Glow VIP (R299/month) membership tiers, priced in ZAR.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- SkinLabs content is written for a South African audience — climate,
  water hardness, UV index, Fitzpatrick skin tones and locally available
  retailers are treated as first-class context, not an afterthought.
- Product reviews and AI-generated skincare recommendations are informational
  and not a substitute for professional dermatological advice.
- Canonical site: https://skinlabs.co.za
- Sitemap: https://skinlabs.co.za/sitemap.xml
